user_story:
As a user, I want to hover over user avatars to reveal profile links so that I can access user profiles easily.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I hover over the first user avatar, I should see a link with text 'View profile' that leads to '/users/1'.
2. When I hover over the second user avatar, I should see a link with text 'View profile' that leads to '/users/2'.
3. When I hover over the third user avatar, I should see a link with text 'View profile' that leads to '/users/3'.
